description: This file defines an API endpoint for creating a new note in a notes application. It handles incoming requests, reads the request body as a CreateNoteDto, simulates an API delay, creates a new Note object, and returns the created note with a success message.

methods.name: index.post.ts
methods.description: API route handler for POST requests to create a new note.

ctags.pattern: /^  const body = await readBody(event) as CreateNoteDto$/
